summary:
Complete Android build.gradle.kts Gradle Kotlin DSL build script for the LPG Manager native application configured with:
- Android SDK 35 and minimum SDK 26 (Android 8.0 Oreo)
- Java 17 / JVM 17 compilation target
- Jetpack Compose 2024.12 BoM and Material 3 design libraries
- Google Firebase BoM 33.7.0, Firebase Authentication, and Cloud Firestore
- Kotlinx Coroutines Android and Play Services coroutines
- Release optimization and ProGuard configurations
